trickyParts: The two defects of this walk are mirrors, and the fix has to hold both: review finding 2 was a false refusal (a conforming comment not credited), the tester's finding was the false acceptance its cure traded for (a non-comment credited). Branch order fixes the first half — a `//` line can never be mistaken for a block close — and the pending-list rule fixes the second, because the only way the old code could walk past code was a climb that never found its opening.

An unterminated block credits nothing rather than failing with a message of its own: the declaration then simply has no attached comment naming the other constant, and the existing cross-reference refusal says so, naming the site and what to write. A malformed tree is thereby refused by the rule it breaks rather than by a new one.
